dedupe_keys.name: unofficial bengaluru bmtc routes and timetables gtfs

description: The bmtc-data repository publishes an unofficial GTFS feed for Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation routes, stops and timetables, plus CSV and GeoJSON views of parts of the same network. A paired repository documents scripts that scrape the Namma BMTC app and convert its route, stop and timetable information. The project says only routes with working live tracking in that app are included. It also warns that timetable and stop-time information is particularly unreliable. The repository contains an ODC-By database licence, while the original app’s rights were not checked. The data repository was last pushed in November 2024; this review did not open the GTFS ZIP or establish each feed file’s validity dates. Its spatial scope is Bengaluru city bus service, with route and stop detail where published. A modeller could use its stop and route network for exploratory accessibility or bus-flow experiments, but should verify current agency service and timing before calibrating schedules. Related catalogue resource data-transitland is a broader directory and archive of transit feeds; this repository is a specific community-built BMTC extraction. The record does not treat it as an official or complete transit schedule. Its simulation use is exploratory network-flow and service-capacity planning.
licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) in this repository; underlying Namma BMTC app rights are not separately verified.
